messages:
Aria Vance: Quick PSA — the TypeScript Next starter (LangChain + LlamaIndex) we hand out has a subtle export shape that breaks the JS SDK's automatic idempotency detection in server runtimes.
Aria Vance: Repro: run starter locally with app router SSR, call /api/ssr-query once -> telemetry shows two upstream calls and doubled tokens.
Noel Kim: Hmm. What do you mean by "export shape"? Can you paste the handler file?
Aria Vance: Here's the relevant file: app/api/query/route.ts (simplified)
```ts
export const runtime = 'edge'
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { q } = await req.json()
  // NOTE: we re-export a helper below which changes the module resolution shape
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(await client.chat.create({ model: 'rw-llama-7b', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: q }] })))
}
export default function helper() { /* used by tests only */ }
```
Hector Alvarez: Ah — the presence of default export in a TS module compiled to ESM changed how our server runtime detection ran in the starter. The SDK's runtime auto-detection missed 'server' context because of a bundler quirk and therefore didn't enable auto-idempotency.
Aria Vance: Logs show: 
[2026-08-03T11:42:01Z] sdk: runtime_detected=browser autoIdempotency=false
[2026-08-03T11:42:01Z] transport: fetch retry attempt=2
[2026-08-03T11:42:02Z] sdk: retry attempt=2 idempotency=null
Aria Vance: So transport retried (fetch polyfill) then sdk retried too, no idempotency -> double-run.
Noel Kim: Yikes. Short term: change starter handler to explicitly pass { autoIdempotency: true } to createClient in server files and update README. Also remove default export from server route files to avoid the bundler quirk.
Hector Alvarez: Long term: SDK should use more robust server-runtime detection (check process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME, typeof window, and import.meta.env.VERCEL_ENV) and allow an explicit server flag in createClient({ serverSide: true }). Also fallback to adding idempotency on any runtime that returns falsey for window.
Aria Vance: I patched my local starter: removed default export, set createClient({ apiKey: ..., serverSide: true }). Duplicate calls disappeared.
devex-bot: Created issue: starter-templates#789 "ts-starter: export shape causes runtime auto-detect failure -> double inference" assigned to @Noel Kim
Noel Kim: I'll open a PR to adjust the starter templates (detect and set serverSide in server files) and add a lint rule in the starter repo to forbid default exports in api route files. Also add a test that asserts createClient was instantiated with autoIdempotency in server contexts.
Hector Alvarez: I'll add an SDK change to honor an explicit serverSide flag and improve detection heuristics. We'll also add a small integration test in the SDK acceptance suite that compiles a minimal TS route with/without default exports to ensure detection remains stable across bundlers.
Aria Vance: Thanks — this one was obscure. Good to tighten the starter so new users don't stumble into doubled charges.
Noel Kim: PR WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-templates/pull/201 — will ping once ready for review. :thumbsup:
